description: This file defines the StatusWindow class, a Java Swing GUI component for displaying and managing a status window with log messages and a driver link in a larger application.

classes.name: StatusWindow
classes.description: A GUI component that provides a window with a text area for logs and a link to a driver URL, with methods to show the window and append messages.

methods.name: StatusWindow
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the status window with components, including a URL label and a scrollable text area.

methods.name: getFrameHelper
methods.description: Returns the FrameHelper instance managing the window frame.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Returns the main JPanel containing the status window content.

methods.name: getFrame
methods.description: Returns the JFrame associated with the window.

methods.name: showFrame
methods.description: Displays the window with a specified title, centers it, and clears previous log messages.

methods.name: appendMsg
methods.description: Appends a message to the log text area asynchronously.
